command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=8 SKR_THREADS=8
cd /tmp
echo "== staged bytes must match their pins =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged input does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
lscpu | grep -iE 'model name|^cpu\(s\)|numa node\(s\)' > cpu.txt; cat cpu.txt
T0=$(date +%s)
python3 -u real.py > real.log 2>&1
RC=$?
echo "real.py exit $RC in $(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))s"
cat real.log
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: the workload failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'SKLEARN REAL OK' real.log || { echo "FAIL: no completion sentinel"; exit 1; }
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo DONE
